meta.name: The Gardener
meta.description:
Elmer's mother used his lack of feelings to turn him into a hitman. But when he falls for his next victim, their cover as calm local gardeners wavers.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Atlantic Landscape
videos.overview: Elmer, an assassin posing as a gardener, is tasked with killing Violeta, a seemingly troubled young woman. The police catch wind of a suspected murder.

videos.title: Seed Germination
videos.overview: As Violeta and Elmer grow closer, he lands a new victim. News about his health and newfound feelings lead him to consider defying his mother's orders.

videos.title: Organic Substrate
videos.overview: China debates finishing Elmer's job for him. The search for a missing person sparks questions about Violeta's past and her latest partner.

videos.title: Pest Control
videos.overview: Torres and Carrera visit a professor who may be able to help them. Mother and son grow distant as Elmer tries to convince Violeta to spend time together.

videos.title: Decomposition Island
videos.overview: Elmer considers resuming his assignment after an argument with Violeta. Torres and Carrera scope out a possible location of their prime suspect.

videos.title: Pruning Calendar
videos.overview: Violeta and Elmer both face the reality of their situation. China offers her son a way out — but can he trust her to hide the evidence from the police?
